_note: Key names are KeyboardEvent.code values. Player 1 steers with the arrows (up rows faster, down brakes); player 2 with A/D (W rows faster, S brakes). Player 1 (red): arrows, A = O, B = P, C = L, START = Enter. Player 2 (blue): W A S D, A = R, B = T, C = F, START = 2. The cabinet's encoder sends Left Ctrl, Left Alt, Space and 1 for player 1's buttons; its player 2 buttons must send R, T and F. With one player, either set works. Change keys here, not in code.
